instruction: Candid documentary photograph, high-angle medium shot. In a brightly lit indoor dojo with polished wooden floors and black training mats, the girl in the pink gi (R2) kneels over the woman in the black gi (R1). The girl in the pink gi (R2) grips the lapel of the woman in the black gi (R1) with her right hand, looking down with a focused expression. The woman in the black gi (R1) sits on the mat, leaning back on her hands and defending from an open guard position. Natural side lighting from a nearby window illuminates the sparring partners, casting soft shadows on the black mat.
